glossary.name: Vesper-Threshold
glossary.simpleEnglish: The vast twilight realm where dead souls arrive, now industrialized by the Chancery of Scales.
glossary.explanation: The vast twilight realm where dead souls arrive, now industrialized by the Chancery of Scales.

glossary.name: Chancery of Scales
glossary.simpleEnglish: The ruling afterlife bureaucracy that taxes memory and administers Vesper-Threshold through brass ledgers.
glossary.explanation: The ruling afterlife bureaucracy that taxes memory and administers Vesper-Threshold through brass ledgers.

glossary.name: Aether-Ash
glossary.simpleEnglish: Luminous ash distilled from residual mortal memory, burned to power city lamps, furnaces, and longevity elixirs.
glossary.explanation: Luminous ash distilled from residual mortal memory, burned to power city lamps, furnaces, and longevity elixirs.

glossary.name: The Pale Reach
glossary.simpleEnglish: The endless, salt-swept frontier outside the Lantern-Wall where forgotten ages and exiles dwell.
glossary.explanation: The endless, salt-swept frontier outside the Lantern-Wall where forgotten ages and exiles dwell.

glossary.name: Unstamped
glossary.simpleEnglish: An arriving soul whose brass tally shattered or was never logged, leaving them outside Chancery law.
glossary.explanation: An arriving soul whose brass tally shattered or was never logged, leaving them outside Chancery law.

glossary.name: Soul-Tally
glossary.simpleEnglish: A stamped brass identification tag recording an arrival's debt balance and labor assignment.
glossary.explanation: A stamped brass identification tag recording an arrival's debt balance and labor assignment.

glossary.name: The Mist-Weir
glossary.simpleEnglish: The dark, fog-shrouded river across which mortal souls arrive by barge at Weir-Port.
glossary.explanation: The dark, fog-shrouded river across which mortal souls arrive by barge at Weir-Port.

glossary.name: The Quiet Oar
glossary.simpleEnglish: Ancient emblem of the Oar-Keepers' Union representing free, peaceful passage before the Chancery.
glossary.explanation: Ancient emblem of the Oar-Keepers' Union representing free, peaceful passage before the Chancery.

glossary.name: First Seal of Quiet
glossary.simpleEnglish: The fractured silver ring that originally granted dead souls peaceful rest before the Chancery chained it.
glossary.explanation: The fractured silver ring that originally granted dead souls peaceful rest before the Chancery chained it.

glossary.name: The Unwritten
glossary.simpleEnglish: Exiled and ash-altered souls cast beyond the Lantern-Wall who built a solemn kingdom in the Hollow Nave.
glossary.explanation: Exiled and ash-altered souls cast beyond the Lantern-Wall who built a solemn kingdom in the Hollow Nave.

glossary.name: Furnace Guild
glossary.simpleEnglish: The industrial alchemists and kiln-barons who refine Aether-Ash and control the Ash-Quarry.
glossary.explanation: The industrial alchemists and kiln-barons who refine Aether-Ash and control the Ash-Quarry.

glossary.name: Quiet Reformers
glossary.simpleEnglish: Principled clerks, archivists, and councilors inside the Chancery working to end debt-forfeiture.
glossary.explanation: Principled clerks, archivists, and councilors inside the Chancery working to end debt-forfeiture.

glossary.name: Order of the Last Bell
glossary.simpleEnglish: Monastic bronze-casters who toll consecrated bells to soothe tormented spirits and aid refugees.
glossary.explanation: Monastic bronze-casters who toll consecrated bells to soothe tormented spirits and aid refugees.

glossary.name: Mnemonic Collegium
glossary.simpleEnglish: Arcane scholars of the Glass Conservatory who preserve bottled memories without burning them.
glossary.explanation: Arcane scholars of the Glass Conservatory who preserve bottled memories without burning them.

glossary.name: Black-Ledger Brokers
glossary.simpleEnglish: Ruthless debt-traffickers who buy delinquent soul-contracts and collect through intimidation.
glossary.explanation: Ruthless debt-traffickers who buy delinquent soul-contracts and collect through intimidation.

glossary.name: Lantern-Wall
glossary.simpleEnglish: The fortified basalt border wall separating the lit Chancery districts from the wild Pale Reach.
glossary.explanation: The fortified basalt border wall separating the lit Chancery districts from the wild Pale Reach.

glossary.name: Pale Frontier Wardens
glossary.simpleEnglish: Hardened border rangers holding the viaducts and bastion gates against frontier threats.
glossary.explanation: Hardened border rangers holding the viaducts and bastion gates against frontier threats.

glossary.name: Unstamped Freebooters
glossary.simpleEnglish: Smugglers and frontier runners operating from the cisterns beneath Weir-Port.
glossary.explanation: Smugglers and frontier runners operating from the cisterns beneath Weir-Port.

glossary.name: Weeping Amber
glossary.simpleEnglish: Translucent golden resin from the Weeping Glass Orchard that preserves dying oaths.
glossary.explanation: Translucent golden resin from the Weeping Glass Orchard that preserves dying oaths.

glossary.name: Bell-Bronze
glossary.simpleEnglish: Resonant monastic alloy whose chimes weaken corrupted spirits and reinforce shields.
glossary.explanation: Resonant monastic alloy whose chimes weaken corrupted spirits and reinforce shields.

glossary.name: Pale-Iron
glossary.simpleEnglish: Dense grey iron mined from the Great Ash-Quarry, prized by foundry smiths.
glossary.explanation: Dense grey iron mined from the Great Ash-Quarry, prized by foundry smiths.

glossary.name: Fulgurite Ash-Quartz
glossary.simpleEnglish: Lightning-vitrified crystal spires formed during static storms over the Shattered Glass Steppe.
glossary.explanation: Lightning-vitrified crystal spires formed during static storms over the Shattered Glass Steppe.

glossary.name: Shroudweave
glossary.simpleEnglish: Weightless silver-grey filaments spun from vanquished mire-wraiths for arcane vestments.
glossary.explanation: Weightless silver-grey filaments spun from vanquished mire-wraiths for arcane vestments.

glossary.name: Ledger-Law
glossary.simpleEnglish: The Chancery's legal code equating spiritual worth with recorded debt and industrial output.
glossary.explanation: The Chancery's legal code equating spiritual worth with recorded debt and industrial output.

glossary.name: Thirteenth Chime
glossary.simpleEnglish: The bound silent hammer of the Clockwork Belfry symbolizing true rest beyond twelve labor shifts.
glossary.explanation: The bound silent hammer of the Clockwork Belfry symbolizing true rest beyond twelve labor shifts.

glossary.name: Velvet Auction Court
glossary.simpleEnglish: Opulent upper-terrace gallery where patricians bid on expired contracts and longevity wine.
glossary.explanation: Opulent upper-terrace gallery where patricians bid on expired contracts and longevity wine.

glossary.name: The Hollow Nave
glossary.simpleEnglish: Calcified mist-stone cathedral serving as the seat of Regent Malcor and the Unwritten Court.
glossary.explanation: Calcified mist-stone cathedral serving as the seat of Regent Malcor and the Unwritten Court.

glossary.name: The Silent Architect
glossary.simpleEnglish: The forgotten designer of the First Seal whose translucent echo still waits at the Broken Ferry-Arch.
glossary.explanation: The forgotten designer of the First Seal whose translucent echo still waits at the Broken Ferry-Arch.

glossary.name: Arcane Knowledge Points
glossary.simpleEnglish: Global magical progression points earned from skill milestones to permanently acquire new spells in your Grimoire.
glossary.explanation: Global magical progression points earned from skill milestones to permanently acquire new spells in your Grimoire.

glossary.name: Tollcraft
glossary.simpleEnglish: Forbidden Threshold magic that exacts a direct vitality or moral toll in exchange for devastating force.
glossary.explanation: Forbidden Threshold magic that exacts a direct vitality or moral toll in exchange for devastating force.

glossary.name: Vow-Bound Gear
glossary.simpleEnglish: Threshold relics whose properties resonate with the promises, mercy, or ruthlessness of their wielder.
glossary.explanation: Threshold relics whose properties resonate with the promises, mercy, or ruthlessness of their wielder.

glossary.name: Ossuary Ivory
glossary.simpleEnglish: Hardened mist-stone bone gathered in the Ossuary Bastions for blades and sentinel armor.
glossary.explanation: Hardened mist-stone bone gathered in the Ossuary Bastions for blades and sentinel armor.

glossary.name: Threshold Salt
glossary.simpleEnglish: Bitter crystalline mineral blanketing the Pale Reach that preserves memory and wards spirits.
glossary.explanation: Bitter crystalline mineral blanketing the Pale Reach that preserves memory and wards spirits.

glossary.name: Vault of Unpaid Echoes
glossary.simpleEnglish: Subterranean mirror-cistern in the Threshold Abyss holding centuries of confiscated mortal memories.
glossary.explanation: Subterranean mirror-cistern in the Threshold Abyss holding centuries of confiscated mortal memories.

glossary.name: Tempered Kiln-Glass
glossary.simpleEnglish: Volcanic amber-black slag glass prized by Crucible smiths for razor inlays and heat-resistant foci.
glossary.explanation: Volcanic amber-black slag glass prized by Crucible smiths for razor inlays and heat-resistant foci.

glossary.name: Cinder-Pitch Resin
glossary.simpleEnglish: Luminous black-gold resin weeping from the Amber-Vein Catacombs; waterproofs oilskins and fuels alchemy.
glossary.explanation: Luminous black-gold resin weeping from the Amber-Vein Catacombs; waterproofs oilskins and fuels alchemy.

glossary.name: Fulgurite-Silver
glossary.simpleEnglish: Lightning-veined silver formed atop the Shattered Salt-Observatory; the premier alloy for masterwork gear.
glossary.explanation: Lightning-veined silver formed atop the Shattered Salt-Observatory; the premier alloy for masterwork gear.

glossary.name: Muted Bell-Alloy
glossary.simpleEnglish: Ancient pre-Chancery bronze buried in the Crypt of the Muted Bells, resonant against toll-magic.
glossary.explanation: Ancient pre-Chancery bronze buried in the Crypt of the Muted Bells, resonant against toll-magic.

glossary.name: Clockwork Artifice
glossary.simpleEnglish: The craft of assembling brass repeaters, chronometers, and prismatic threshold lanterns from salvaged mainsprings.
glossary.explanation: The craft of assembling brass repeaters, chronometers, and prismatic threshold lanterns from salvaged mainsprings.
